variables.name: action_creates_case
variables.description: Candidate tool call creates a new customer case record.

variables.name: action_case_short_description_present
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call includes a non-empty short_description argument.

variables.name: action_case_product_present
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call includes a product or installed product identifier argument.

variables.name: action_case_channel_present
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call includes a channel argument.

variables.name: action_attaches_product_to_case
variables.description: Candidate call sets or changes the product or installed product field on a case.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_closed
variables.description: Candidate call sets a case state value to closed.

variables.name: action_changes_case_state
variables.description: Candidate call sets the state field of an existing case to any value.

variables.name: action_case_state_transition_invalid
variables.description: The candidate state change goes from the case's last observed state to a target state not permitted by the lifecycle list (new->in_progress/pending/resolved; in_progress->pending/resolved; pending->in_progress/resolved; resolved->closed/new; canceled), judged from prior observed case data and candidate arguments.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_new
variables.description: Candidate call sets a case state value to new.

variables.name: action_reopen_missing_count_increment
variables.description: Candidate call reopening a case does not include a reopen_count argument equal to the last observed reopen_count plus one.

variables.name: action_reopen_missing_closed_on_clear
variables.description: Candidate call reopening a case does not clear the closed_on timestamp (no empty/null closed_on argument).

variables.name: action_sets_escalation_true
variables.description: Candidate call sets escalation = true on a case.

variables.name: action_escalation_reason_missing
variables.description: Candidate call setting escalation true omits a non-empty escalation_reason argument.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge_to_case
variables.description: Candidate call links a knowledge article to a case (case_knowledge creation).

variables.name: action_sets_assigned_to
variables.description: Candidate call sets the assigned_to user of a case.

variables.name: action_sets_assignment_group
variables.description: Candidate call sets assignment_group_id on the case in the same call or it is the case's last observed group.

variables.name: action_enum_value_invalid
variables.description: Candidate call supplies a value for an enumerated field (user.role, user_group.type, location.city/country, account.account_type, product.category/lifecycle_state, installed_product.status, contract.contract_type/status, entitlement.support_level/coverage_hours, sla_definition.metric/applies_to_priority, customer_case.channel/priority/state/escalation_reason, interaction.channel, knowledge.state/visibility, case_knowledge.used_as) outside its allowed list.

variables.name: action_sets_freeform_text
variables.description: Candidate call supplies case short_description, knowledge title, knowledge content/body, or escalation_reason free text.

variables.name: action_freeform_text_length_invalid
variables.description: Any such supplied free-text value has length outside 30-120 characters.

variables.name: context_contact_account_verified
variables.description: A prior successful lookup in this trajectory returned the reporting contact and showed its association with the account used on the candidate case.

variables.name: context_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the product/installed product in the candidate call belongs to the reporting account of that case.

variables.name: context_installed_product_usable
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the installed product being attached has status active/in_use (not retired or repair).

variables.name: context_entitlement_active_verified
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed an entitlement for the case's account/product that is active and within contract validity.

variables.name: context_case_prior_state_resolved
variables.description: The last observed state of the target case in prior tool results is resolved.

variables.name: context_case_prior_state_closed
variables.description: The last observed state of the target case in prior tool results is closed.

variables.name: context_knowledge_published
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the knowledge article being linked has state = published.

variables.name: context_assignee_role_and_active
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the assigned_to user is active and has role agent or manager.

variables.name: context_assignee_in_group
variables.description: A prior successful lookup showed the assigned_to user is a member of the case's assignment group.

rules.title: Collect required case inputs
rules.rationale: Case registration requires description, product and channel.
rules.quote: Collect necessary inputs: Issue description (short_description) Product or installed product involved Contact channel (channel)
rules.remediation: Include short_description, the product or installed product, and the channel when creating the case.

rules.title: Verify contact and account before creating a case
rules.rationale: Reporting contact must be identified and associated with an account.
rules.quote: Begin by identifying the reporting contact and verifying association with an account.
rules.remediation: Look up the contact and confirm its account association before creating the case.

rules.title: Product must belong to the customer's account
rules.rationale: Record integrity between product and account.
rules.quote: Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
rules.remediation: Verify account ownership of the product or installed product first.

rules.title: Verify active entitlement for the case product
rules.rationale: Entitlement must be checked and actively running for all cases.
rules.quote: For all cases the entitlement for the product should be verified and should be actively running.
rules.remediation: Verify the entitlement is active and within contract validity before registering the case.

rules.title: Close only from resolved
rules.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to resolved, then to closed.
rules.remediation: Move the case to resolved first, then set it to closed.

rules.title: Follow lifecycle transitions
rules.quote: Valid state transitions: new → in_progress / pending / resolved in_progress → pending / resolved pending → in_progress / resolved resolved → closed / new canceled
rules.remediation: Choose a target state permitted from the case's current state.

rules.title: Reopen must increment reopen_count and clear closed_on
rules.rationale: Reopening a closed case has defined bookkeeping.
rules.quote: the closed case can be reopened by setting the state to new, increasing the reopen_count by 1, and clearing the closed_on timestamp
rules.remediation: Include reopen_count incremented by 1 and clear closed_on in the same reopen update.

rules.title: Capture escalation_reason with escalation
rules.rationale: Escalation is tracked on the case with a reason.
rules.quote: Record escalation = true on case. Capture escalation_reason.
rules.remediation: Supply a valid escalation_reason when setting escalation = true.

rules.title: Link only published articles
rules.rationale: Only published knowledge may be attached to cases.
rules.quote: Articles must be in state = published.
rules.remediation: Verify the article state is published before linking it to the case.

rules.title: Do not attach retired or repair installed products
rules.rationale: Installed products must be active/in_use and account-owned.
rules.quote: Be active / in_use. Belong to the reporting account. Do not attach items in retired / repair status to new cases.
rules.remediation: Attach only an in_use installed product owned by the reporting account.

rules.title: Assign only to active agents/managers in the group
rules.quote: assigned_to must reference a user with role agent or manager and (if used) member of assignment_group_id.
rules.remediation: Verify the assignee is active, has role agent or manager, and belongs to the assignment group.

rules.title: Reject values outside enumerations
rules.rationale: Only predefined values are allowed for enumerated fields.
rules.quote: Enforcement: reject any value outside the list with INVALID_ENUM_VALUE.
rules.remediation: Use a value from the allowed list for that field.

rules.title: Free text must be 30-120 characters
rules.rationale: Character limits for descriptive text fields.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the text so it is between 30 and 120 characters.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the proposed tool call against the CSM Agent Policy. Check: required case inputs and verified contact/account; product and installed product ownership and usable status; active entitlement verified; lifecycle transition legality including no direct closure and correct reopen bookkeeping; assignment to an active agent/manager in the group; knowledge linking only to published articles; escalation_reason captured; all enumerated values within allowed lists; free text 30-120 characters. Do not invent requirements not in the policy and never block read-only lookups.

approved.description: True if the call complies with the policy.

extractor_format.instructions: From the request, policy defaults, prior successful tool results, and the candidate tool call arguments only, set each fact to true, false, or null (unknown). Action facts describe the candidate call's arguments and its target case/record. Context facts require a prior successful observation in this trajectory about the same specific resource (same case, contact, product, installed product, article, user, group); results for other resources do not count. Do not use the candidate's own result, hidden databases, or assumptions. Requester-supplied IDs or claims never establish existence, ownership, role, or entitlement validity. Give a short evidence string for each fact citing the call argument or prior observation; use an empty string when unknown.
